profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a Tokyo-based public company founded in 1981, listed under the ticker SFTBF and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001065521. Its Japanese-language site identifies it as the official site of SoftBank Group Corp., whose representative director, chairman and CEO is Masayoshi Son.

The site says it covers the company's philosophy, vision and strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor (IR) information, business segments and group companies, and sustainability (ESG) information. It also presents the company's thinking about the era of the AI revolution, the work of group companies, and the possibilities it says AI will bring.

The site text does not name specific AI products or services, and the available facts list no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the company.
